mainText: Why is Wilcox in line of fire from Man Utd fans?. With Michael Carrick's position as Man Utd boss under scrutiny, focus has also turned to director of football Jason Wilcox. Arsenal eye Monza striker Varela - Tuesday's gossip. Portuguese striker Gustavo Varela is on Arsenal's radar, Crystal Palace want to keep winger Ismaila Sarr, Brighton defender Luka Vuskovic receives admiring glances from some of Europe's biggest clubs, plus more. Pennant has more than 50 stitches after dog attack. Former Premier League footballer Jermaine Pennant says he needed more than 50 stitches after being mauled by a dog.

titleText: Other news you might find interesting
mainText: Two charged over alleged plot to assist Iran in RAF Fairford incident. Mohmed Ahmad Abdulkarim and Nouman Essghir, both 24, will appear at Westminster Magistrates' Court on Tuesday. Chancellor to cut tariffs on some staple goods to offer cost of living help. A series of small announcements are part of John Healey's pledge to give households help with the cost of living. Turnout highest since 1977 as Israelis vote in pivotal election. The elections - the first since the Hamas-led attacks on Israel and the war which followed - are widely seen as a referendum on Benjamin Netanyahu. What does Israel's election mean for Gaza and the wider world?. The BBC's diplomatic correspondent James Landale reports from Jerusalem as ballots are cast.
